title: finding(service-automation): a get_record whose fields omit id answers output.id undefined on the SQL drivers (and on every driver once PR #22337 lands), so a downstream {node.id} reference reads nothing
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (b): a declared node output that is not honoured.** reach: read from source on `main` `3599fef1`. It is not measured at runtime; the claimant measures first.

Raised by the `domain:engine` seat's note `6067008874` on #6021, from PR #22337's contract review (`6066975867`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#22300). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021), `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`, which read the source. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## Read from source

- **The output:** `service-automation`'s `get_record` node, on its `findOne` branch (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts`, near `:502`-`:506`), hands the flow author's `config.fields` to the engine as the projection, unchanged. It then answers `output: { record, id: record?.id, object }`.
- **When the projection omits `id`:**
  - on the `driver-sql` family, the engine returns no `id`, so `output.id` is `undefined`;
  - after PR #22337 lands, the same holds on `driver-memory` and `driver-mongodb` for a projection that names a formula field. PR #22337 makes every driver return `id` only when it is named.
- **The consequence:** a flow that narrows `get_record`'s fields and then references the node's `id` (a later `update_record`, a notification link, an assignment) reads `undefined` with no error.
- `get_record` declares `id` as part of its output, so this is a declared output the node does not honour. The `find` branch (`limit > 1`) returns rows only, with no top-level `id`.

## Direction (for triage)

The review's suggestion: `get_record` names `id` in the projection it hands the engine, so `output.id` no longer depends on the author's `fields`. Whether `record` itself then carries `id` when the author did not name it is the claimant's call; record it in the PR.
- Pin it on a SQL driver: with `fields` that omit `id`, `output.id` is the row's id.
- Control: with no `fields`, the output is unchanged.
- ⛔ No change to PR #22337's engine-level trimming.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` 「get_record output id undefined when fields projection omits id flow node」 gave 2 hits:
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22300 (open) is the engine-side formula widening that PR #22337 fixes;
- #8018 (closed) is a console grid.

Neither is this.

Dedupe words: get_record output id undefined projection · flow get_record fields omit id · crud-nodes findOne id projection
